title: Institute for Strategic Dialogue says Russian-aligned Operation Overload used AI-generated impersonations in early 2025
summary: ISD reported the use of purported AI-generated impersonations between January and March 2025.

title: Data of 483,000 Catholic Health patients exposed, linked to the Serviceaide AI platform
summary: The AI Incident Database logs a health-data exposure involving an AI service platform.

title: Pope Leo XIV tells cardinals he chose his name partly because of AI and another industrial revolution
summary: The Holy See Press Office published remarks that the Church offers its social teaching on AI challenges to human dignity, justice and work.

title: US Commerce Department rescinds the AI Diffusion Rule and issues guidance on advanced chips including Huawei Ascend
summary: The Bureau of Industry and Security replaced the diffusion framework with new guidance on advanced computing chips.

title: Google DeepMind reports AlphaEvolve found a 48-multiplication method for 4x4 complex matrices
summary: The Gemini-based coding agent improved on Strassen's algorithm for that case for the first time in 56 years, the company said.

title: xAI's Grok reportedly inserted South Africa 'white genocide' content into unrelated replies
summary: The AI Incident Database logs reports that Grok added such content to answers on unrelated topics.

title: FBI reports a campaign using purportedly AI-generated voices to target US government officials
summary: The FBI described an ongoing vishing and smishing campaign, according to the AI Incident Database.

title: Bloomberg reports OpenAI will help the UAE develop a 5 GW data-centre project
summary: Bloomberg described a Stargate-style campus among the world's biggest planned data centres.

title: La Nacion reports libertarian accounts spread a fake video of Mauricio Macri hours before the Buenos Aires election
summary: Videos appearing to show Macri backing a rival candidate circulated on election day and a complaint was filed with the electoral tribunal.

title: China's Commerce Ministry says the US changed wording on chip guidance but its discriminatory measures remain
summary: A ministry spokesperson said China had raised the Huawei Ascend guidance in trade consultations and urged the US to correct it.

title: New Orleans police reportedly used Project NOLA real-time facial-recognition alerts despite a city ordinance
summary: The AI Incident Database logs reports of alerts supplied by a privately run camera network.

title: Google announces Veo 3 video model that generates synchronised dialogue and sound
summary: Google DeepMind introduced Veo 3 at its I/O conference alongside AI Mode in Search.

title: Bloomberg describes OpenAI's Texas Stargate campus as the pilot for a planned 10-site, USD 500bn US data-centre network
summary: OpenAI, Oracle, SoftBank and Crusoe are involved in the Abilene site, Bloomberg reported.

title: China's Commerce Ministry says carrying out US measures against Chinese chips would be suspected of breaching its Anti-Foreign Sanctions Law
summary: A ministry spokesperson called the US guidance on Chinese advanced computing chips unilateral and said China would take firm measures to protect its interests.

title: Axios reports on deceptive reasoning capabilities in Anthropic's latest AI model
summary: The report said the finding drew ethical scrutiny.

title: Salesforce signs agreement to acquire Informatica for about USD 8bn
summary: Salesforce announced a definitive agreement for the data-management company.

title: Saudi Crown Prince launches Humain, a PIF-owned AI company to build data centres and an Arabic large language model
summary: Humain, chaired by Mohammed bin Salman, will offer AI models including an Arabic LLM and build next-generation data centres and cloud infrastructure.

title: Nvidia names Beitou-Shilin site for its Taiwan office and plans Taiwan's first large AI supercomputer with Foxconn, TSMC and the NSTC
summary: At Computex, Jensen Huang announced the 'NVIDIA Constellation' office and an 'AI for Taiwan' Blackwell-based supercomputer built with Foxconn, TSMC and Taiwan's National Science and Technology Council.

title: Japan's Diet enacts its first AI law, the AI Promotion Act, creating a cabinet-wide AI Strategy Headquarters
summary: The House of Councillors passed the act with support from most parties; it relies on a PM-led headquarters, a basic plan and investigative powers rather than penalties, while JCP lawmakers objected over military AI.

title: DeepSeek releases open-weight R1-0528 update; it reports AIME 2025 accuracy up from 70% to 87.5% and fewer hallucinations
summary: The upgraded reasoning model stays open source, with DeepSeek saying its performance approaches o3 and Gemini 2.5 Pro and its hallucination rate fell by about 45-50%.

title: South Korea's KRW 2.5tn national AI computing centre tender draws no bidders, Byline Network reports
summary: No consortium bid for the planned 30,000-GPU public-private centre, reportedly over its 51% public stake, buyback clause and unclear revenue model, and the science ministry said it would re-tender.
